title: Storage & backups
description: tank pool, SMART, scrubs and the NVMe backup. Data: host/disk-health and host/nvme-backup (textfile collector, every 5 min) + node_exporter's zfs collector.

panels.title: Pool tank
panels.description: From the kernel. Alert: ZFS pool not ONLINE.

panels.title: Disks online
panels.description: Pool members ONLINE (of 3). Alert: ZFS pool disk not ONLINE / Pool disks missing.

panels.title: Disk I/O errors
panels.description: Read+write+checksum errors across pool members since last zpool clear.

panels.title: Data errors
panels.description: Files with permanent errors. `zpool status -v tank` lists them.

panels.title: SMART
panels.description: Every drive's overall self-assessment.

panels.title: Days since scrub
panels.description: Alert at 40 days (not while a scrub is running).

panels.title: NVMe backup
panels.description: Result of the last nightly run (host/nvme-backup).

panels.title: Last good backup
panels.description: Alert at 30 h.

panels.title: Health job ran
panels.description: disk-health.timer runs every 5 min. Alert at 30 min (metrics stale).

panels.title: Hottest HDD
panels.description: Alert above 50 °C.

panels.title: NVMe temp
panels.description: Alert above 70 °C.

panels.title: NVMe wear
panels.description: Endurance used. Alert above 80%.

panels.title: Pool used
panels.description: Raw allocation incl. parity (zpool list CAP). ZFS slows down past ~80%.

panels.title: Usable free
panels.description: What you can still write, after parity (zfs list AVAIL).

panels.title: Used by dataset
panels.description: Top-level datasets incl. their children and snapshots. 'tank' = files stored directly in the root dataset.

panels.title: Held only by snapshots
panels.description: Freed if that dataset's snapshots are destroyed (`zfs list -t snapshot -o name,used -s used`).

panels.title: Drives
panels.description: Reallocated sectors already remapped (yellow = watch it, alert fires if it grows). Pending/uncorrectable = sectors that can't be read now. CRC = cable/enclosure, not the disk. ZFS errors = worst of read/write/checksum for that member.

panels.title: Reallocated sectors
panels.description: Flat is fine. A rising line means the disk is actively failing sectors.

panels.title: Pool disk throughput
panels.description: Reads up, writes down. sd* = the three pool disks.

panels.title: Pool disk busy
panels.description: Fraction of time the disk had I/O in flight. Pegged at 100% = the disk is the bottleneck (scrubs, Plex scans, PhotoPrism indexing).

panels.title: ARC size
panels.description: ARC gives memory back under pressure, but on a 3.3 GB box it competes with the containers.
